ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and along the trailing edge border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by 3-5 pixel amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in convex, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, textured brownish-black pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicating significant surface irregularity.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the white ventral surface of the left lobe and lower-left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textural irregularities and pigmentation anomalies at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with long-term mechanical or biological colonization.
